prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
promptZh: 請聽錄音，選出最適當的回應。
spokenPrompt: I thought the readings had been approved because the sheet says “Final.”
spokenPromptZh: 這張表上寫著「定稿」，我以為量測數值已獲核准。

options.text: The sheet is in the shared folder.
options.zh: 這張表在共用資料夾裡。
options.whyZh: 檔案存放位置並不能證明數值是否獲准或「定稿」指哪一部分。

options.text: I can print another copy of the sheet.
options.zh: 我可以再印一份這張表。
options.whyZh: 印另一份也只是複製原表，沒有澄清數值是否已獲核准。

options.text: That refers to the layout. The measurements still need to be reviewed.
options.zh: 「定稿」是指版面。量測數值仍然需要審查。
options.whyZh: 說明 Final 只描述版面，不表示裡面的量測數值已核准，直接更正原本的推斷。

explanationZh: 說明 Final 只描述版面，不表示裡面的量測數值已核准，直接更正原本的推斷。
evidence: I thought the readings had been approved because the sheet says “Final.” / That refers to the layout. The measurements still need to be reviewed.

vocabulary.note: 回應中的 that 指表上的 Final，而不是指整份表已全部核准。
